headline: Erdemir posts $201 million net profit in the first half of 2026
summary: Turkish steelmaker Erdemir reported a net profit of $201 million in the first half of 2026. Chairman Murat Yalçıntaş said the company is moving toward low-carbon, green steel.
why: Erdemir is Turkey's largest integrated steel producer, so its profits and strategy reflect conditions in the global steel industry and Turkish manufacturing.
